name: Kaspaland aerial traffic
summary: Luminescent craft weaving through the holo-skyline - backdrop to the rooftop anomaly.
bodyMarkdown: Described from the [[location:kasparex-rooftop|Kasparex rooftop]]: vehicles zip through the sky leaving **streaks of luminescent blue**, part of the living motion of [[location:kaspaland|Kaspaland]].

name: Krex's cybernetic glasses / visor
summary: Signature neon eyewear and combat visor for holographic command layers.
bodyMarkdown: Krex's iconic **neon glasses** reflect data rain; his **visor** (activated in [[chapter:chapter-01-the-heart-of-kasparex|Chapter 1]]) envelops him in holographic displays. On the rooftop, the glasses **auto-enhance** distortions in the cybernetic sky.

name: Vector's diamond processing machines
summary: Lore crossover: special machines that process Krex Diamonds in the Minecore grid.
bodyMarkdown: Per [Minecore](/games/minecore) lore, **Vector** builds machines that process condensed network-energy crystals; **ARIA** monitors the pipeline. Chronicles treats this as the same universe's industrial layer beneath [[location:kaspaland|Kaspaland]] and the [[location:minecore-complex|Minecore Complex]].
